import os
fd = os.open('/data/n.txt', os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
print(os.write(fd, b'hello'), os.write(fd, b' world'))
os.close(fd)
fd = os.open('/data/n.txt', os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND)
os.write(fd, b'!')
os.close(fd)
fd = os.open('/data/n.txt', os.O_RDWR)
os.lseek(fd, 6, os.SEEK_SET)
os.write(fd, b'W')
os.fsync(fd)
os.ftruncate(fd, 8)
print(os.fstat(fd).st_size)
os.close(fd)
try:
    os.open('/data/n.txt', os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL)
except OSError as e:
    print(type(e).__name__)
print(open('/data/n.txt').read())
program.node:
const fsp = require('node:fs').promises
const f = await fsp.open('/data/n.txt', 'wx')
console.log((await f.write('hello')).bytesWritten, (await f.write(' world')).bytesWritten)
await f.close()
await fsp.appendFile('/data/n.txt', '!')
const g = await fsp.open('/data/n.txt', 'r+')
await g.write('W', 6)
await g.sync()
await g.truncate(8)
console.log((await g.stat()).size)
await g.close()
await fsp.open('/data/n.txt', 'wx').catch((e) => console.log(e.code))
console.log(await fsp.readFile('/data/n.txt', 'utf8'))
